query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing unexpected temperature profile variations in our atmospheric distillation unit. Can you help diagnose potential root causes?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and diagnose the potential root causes of unexpected temperature profile variations in an atmospheric distillation unit, focusing on process parameters, equipment performance, and operational conditions.

communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Sequential problem decomposition and integrated analysis

clarification_questions: When did you first notice the unexpected temperature variations in the distillation unit?
Have there been any recent changes in feed composition or operating conditions?
Can you provide detailed temperature profiles and operating data before and after the variations occurred?
Are there any alarms or anomalies in the control system?
